{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: JSAUX USB-C to USB A Cable 3.1A Fast Charging [2-Pack 6.6ft], USB Type C Charger Cord Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S10 S9 S8 S20 Plus A51 A12 A11, Note 10 9 8, PS5 Controller USB C Charger-Green; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do buy practical cables, but I have no current need for these specific charging connections.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger Alexa display interests me, but I recently added a Show 5 and its stand, so I would pass this time.
ItemID: 3; Title: Logitech MX Keys Mini Minimalist Wireless Illuminated Keyboard, Compact, Bluetooth, Backlit, USB-C, Compatible with Apple macOS, iOS, Windows, Linux, Android, Metal Build - Graphite; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I just bought a full-size Macally keyboard with a numeric keypad; this compact model does not fit my immediate needs.
ItemID: 4; Title: Samsung 970 EVO Plus SSD 2TB NVMe M.2 Internal Solid State Hard Drive, V-NAND Technology, Storage and Memory Expansion for Gaming, Graphics w/ Heat Control, Max Speed, MZ-V7S2T0B/AM; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My storage purchases have been external, and I have no planned internal upgrade or confirmed compatible computer.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The clock would be useful, but it overlaps closely with the fourth-generation Dot I recently bought.
ItemID: 6; Title: USB Type C to 3.5mm Female Headphone Jack Adapter, JSAUX USB C to Aux Audio Dongle Cable Cord Compatible with Pixel 4 3 2 XL, Samsung Galaxy S22 S21 S20 Ultra S20+ Note 10 S10 S9 Plus, iPad Pro(Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current headphone connection problem or confirmed device compatibility that would justify buying it.
ItemID: 7; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to explore connected home security; Alexa compatibility fits my recent devices and builds on my earlier door alarm purchase.
ItemID: 8; Title: SanDisk 256GB Extreme microSDXC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - Up to 160MB/s, C10, U3, V30, 4K, A2, Micro SD - SDSQXA1-256G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Removable storage fits my past purchases, but I would wait until I need more capacity and confirm my device supports it.
ItemID: 9; Title: AINOPE 2 Pack USB 3.0 Extension Cable Type A Male to Female Extension Cord 3.3FT Durable Braided Material Fast Data Transfer Compatible with USB Keyboard,Mouse,Flash Drive, Hard Drive,Printer-Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these to make USB ports easier to reach for my card reader and other computer peripherals.
ItemID: 10; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought the second-generation Show 5 and a matching stand, so this older version adds little for me."}
